items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Gilbert Newman. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, Dwight Newman. Good piano. Great piano. Pianist. And he had the job at the Music Box. He had a little son. Was in my wife's room.

ctx.x: Now I was playing at the time when Duran and Humphrey band was together. And then that time. I was playing all over that time. They were playing at the Alamo. And at the Music Box. Then, how you call that boy used to be in your room? His daddy taught him to play music. He played that trumpet so well. Dwight Newman.

Well, Dwight Newman. Good piano. Great piano. Pianist. And he had the job at the Music Box. He had a little son. Was in my wife's room. My wife teaches public school. Joseph. Joseph. You talking about the trumpet player. You know, you ain't play high side on the trumpet. Just like you played on the clarinet. He could play it on trumpet like that. He was a good little player. And he was no bigger than that. Oh, he was good. He was good. He was good. He's gone, I bet. Yeah, oh, he's in New York. He's in New York.…
